title: Concept: Optional dependency group with no version constraint
description: pyproject.toml declares an entry in an optional-dependencies group that names only the package, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Extras install on whoever's machine asks for them, so an unpinned group resolves a different tree in every environment.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pyproject.toml (pypi).
risk: Extras install on whoever's machine asks for them, so an unpinned group resolves a different tree in every environment.
